ctaHeading: Newport's cleaners are ready — let's refresh your property.
aboutText: Hobsons Bay Exterior Cleaning brings a decade of expertise to Newport, offering top-notch exterior cleaning services. From deck restoration to gutter clearing, we handle it all with precision and care. Our commitment to customer satisfaction has made us a trusted name in the community. Whether it's a residential or commercial job, we deliver exceptional results every time.
servicesText: We provide a wide range of exterior cleaning services to keep your property in pristine condition. Our team uses professional equipment and eco-friendly products to ensure effective and safe cleaning. From roofs to gardens, no task is too big or too small for us.

services.title: Deck Cleaning
services.desc: Restore and protect your timber deck with our professional cleaning and sealing services, ensuring longevity and aesthetic appeal.

services.title: Pressure Washing
services.desc: Remove dirt, grime, and stains from driveways, paths, and walls with our high-pressure washing techniques.

services.title: Gardening Services
services.desc: Maintain your outdoor spaces with our comprehensive gardening services, including mowing, trimming, and garden clean-ups.

services.title: Gutter Cleaning
services.desc: Prevent water damage by keeping your gutters clear and free-flowing with our thorough cleaning service.

services.title: House Soft Washing
services.desc: Safely clean your home's exterior surfaces with our soft washing method, ideal for delicate materials.

services.title: Roof Cleaning
services.desc: Enhance your roof's appearance and extend its life by removing moss, algae, and debris with our specialised cleaning.

reviews.text: Hobsons Bay Exterior Cleaning provided exceptional deck cleaning services at our Newport home. Their team was professional, efficient, and left our deck looking brand new. We highly recommend them for any exterior cleaning needs.
reviews.name: Steve Thompson

reviews.text: We hired them for pressure washing our commercial property and were impressed with the thoroughness and attention to detail. Great service from start to finish, and they completed the job on time.
reviews.name: Linda Chen

reviews.text: Their gutter cleaning service saved us from potential water damage. The crew was punctual, efficient, and left the area spotless. I'll definitely use them again for my rental properties in Newport.
reviews.name: Mark O'Brien
